## Automate email copywriting with AI.

Don’t waste more time staring at a blank email draft. With HubSpot’s AI email writer, you can automate email copywriting and delight your audience with a constant stream of valuable, click-worthy content. 

Whether you’re crafting a sales outreach email or working on an email blast campaign, HubSpot’s AI email generator can help. The software is built into HubSpot’s marketing and sales tools, so you can easily draft, send, track, and analyze your email efforts in one place.

  
  

1.  ### Quickly design and write email marketing campaigns.
    
    With HubSpot, you can easily design and draft your emails in one platform. Select and customize an email marketing template of your choice, and then use the slash and highlight commands to generate and edit emails on your marketing emails on demand. Once your campaign launches, your HubSpot CRM database automatically records campaign data for you, so you can track open rates, lead submissions, and more.
    
    ![HubSpot AI generated sales outreach email](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/\(2\)%20hubspot%20ai%20generated%20sales%20outreach%20email.png?width=600&name=\(2\)%20hubspot%20ai%20generated%20sales%20outreach%20email.png)
    
    Click to enlarge
    
2.  ### Nail outreach with AI-generated sales emails.
    
    Your prospects receive dozens of cold outreach emails a week. It takes creativity and persistence to stand out. With HubSpot’s AI email writer, you can generate hundreds of sales email drafts in minutes. Easily customize emails using slash and highlight commands to edit length, spelling, and tone. Then track progress seamlessly using your HubSpot CRM database to automatically log conversations, contacts, and more.
    
    ![Send AI generated emails from your inbox](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/\(3\)%20send%20ai%20generated%20emails%20from%20your%20inbox.png?width=600&name=\(3\)%20send%20ai%20generated%20emails%20from%20your%20inbox.png)
    
    Click to enlarge
    
3.  ### Design, draft, and track emails in one platform.
    
    HubSpot’s integrated AI email writing software simplifies the process of drafting, designing, and tracking emails. Avoid data silos and connect with customers using our native email tools on desktop or on the go with the HubSpot mobile app.
    
    ![AI email writing software options within Gmail](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/\(4\)%20ai%20email%20writing%20software%20options%20within%20Gmail.png?width=600&name=\(4\)%20ai%20email%20writing%20software%20options%20within%20Gmail.png)
    
    Click to enlarge
    
4.  ### Boost open rates with email segmentation.
    
    As your business grows, your audience becomes increasingly diverse. Sending everyone the same content just won’t do. HubSpot’s AI email generator helps you quickly develop on-brand messaging for each of your audience segments, helping you boost open rates and engagement.
    
    ![Personalizing emails with HubSpot AI email writer](https://www.hubspot.com/hs-fs/hubfs/\(5\)%20personalizing%20emails%20with%20hubspot%20ai%20email%20writer.png?width=600&name=\(5\)%20personalizing%20emails%20with%20hubspot%20ai%20email%20writer.png)
    
    Click to enlarge

# How to use AI in email marketing: A practical guide

Email marketing is one of the best ways to communicate with your audience and generate leads. What happens when AI comes into play?

By Sitecore Staff

4 minute read

![Group of paper airplane in same one direction  and with one individual pointing in the different way, can be used leadership/individuality/innovation concepts.( 3d render )](https://delivery-sitecore.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/api/public/content/37f2069ec86a4200b6b171722c6946df?t=sc700x700)

## AI is a tool for driving better results

With [69% of marketers](https://contentmarketinginstitute.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/b2b-2023-research-final.pdf) using email marketing to disseminate their content, email remains a pivotal tool for businesses to connect with their audience, build relationships, and drive conversions. However, with the rapid evolution of AI, traditional digital marketing strategies seem to give way to new ways of communicating with audiences.

AI is revolutionizing how email campaigns are conceptualized, executed, and optimized, leading to enhanced engagement, personalization, and ultimately, better results. Why should you care and how can you incorporate AI into email marketing campaigns?

## Understanding AI in email marketing

[Artificial intelligence](https://www.sitecore.com/solutions/topics/artificial-intelligence), in the context of email marketing, refers to the application of advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques to automate and optimize various aspects of email campaigns. From analyzing user behavior to predicting preferences, AI-driven email marketing goes beyond simple segmentation and delivers highly targeted content that resonates with individual recipients.

Natural language generation AI solutions are trained to analyze large datasets and work with big data to make predictions and provide recommendations that significantly boost email marketing personalization and segmentation.

## The current state of AI in email marketing

While AI in email marketing might sound like something coming from the (near) future, artificial intelligence is already everywhere when it comes to your campaigns.

From spam filters and inbox organization to product recommendations and optimized send times, AI’s multiple use cases are the reason email marketing is still one of the most powerful tool to take your business to the next level.

Here's an overview of the state of AI in email marketing today:

**Personalization:** With the help of AI marketers can send more relevant and engaging emails, leading to higher open and click-through rates.

**Segmentation:** AI-driven segmentation is more sophisticated than ever, with marketers using machine learning algorithms to identify and group subscribers with similar characteristics or behaviors, enabling more targeted email campaigns.

**Predictive analytics:** Timely and relevant emails are not a privilege for the few. AI can predict user behavior, such as the likelihood of a subscriber making a purchase or unsubscribing, allowing marketers to send campaigns to the right person, at the right time.

**A/B testing:** AI-powered A/B testing tools help marketers optimize email subject lines, content, and send times to maximize engagement and conversions.

**Automation:** Automated email scheduling, list management, and even responses to common customer queries are among the most commonly used strategies, thanks to AI-driven automation tools.

**Behavioral triggers:** AI is being used to trigger emails based on specific user behaviors, such as abandoned cart reminders or re-engagement emails for inactive subscribers.

**Data analysis:** AI-powered analytics tools help marketers gain deeper insights into email campaign performance and customer behavior, enabling data-driven decision-making.

**Anti-spam:** AI is used to improve email deliverability by identifying and filtering out spammy content.

## 7 ways to integrate AI into your email marketing campaigns

Thanks to AI, sending better emails is now easier than ever. Integrating AI into your email marketing campaigns can help you do better content marketing, improve engagement, and optimize your campaigns for better results.

Here are the best ways to integrate AI into your email marketing efforts:

1.  **Personalize your emails:** Creating compelling and relevant email content that resonates with your audience is one of the most challenging aspects of email marketing. Thankfully, AI allows users to create smarter, more effective, and more creative email copy that converts.  
       
    For example, you can use SmartWriter or Rasa.io to automate your entire research and copywriting process and send unique personalized emails to your recipients.  
       
    Or you can choose tools that predict your audiences’ preferences and needs, so you can send them emails that they actually want to open and read. Additionally, you can use A/B testing to compare different versions of a single email to see what works best for your audience or potential customers.  
     
2.  **Boost open rates with compelling subject lines:** AI technology allows users to generate new subject line ideas or test and optimize existing ones.  
       
    Tools like Phrasee, SubjectLine, and CoSchedule Headline Analyzer use natural language processing and machine learning to create subject lines that are catchy and effective.  
       
    And subject line optimization tools like Touchstone and AWeber, can analyze subject line performance data and suggest subject lines that are more likely to suit your audience and increase open rates.  
     
3.  **Segment your lists for better results:** If you’re looking to stay relevant, and increase email opens, clicks, and conversion, smart list segmentation should be your top priority.  
       
    AI tools analyze your email data, identify patterns, trends, and correlations, and allow you to group your audience based on their interests, behaviors, and preferences.  
     
4.  **Leverage automation:** Email marketing can be time-consuming and complex to manage. How can you achieve better results in less time?  
       
    Thanks to AI email you can set up AI-driven automated workflows, such as drip campaigns or behavior-triggered emails sent when a subscriber takes a specific action on your website or exhibits certain behaviors.  
       
    Some of the most common marketing automation email campaign types are:  
     
    *   Welcome email campaign
    *   Cart abandonment campaign
    *   Post-purchase campaign
    *   Retargeting campaign
    *   Stand
